profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Software engineer with expertise in JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Node.js, and SQL and NoSQL databases. I thrive on creating responsive, user-focused solutions that combine elegant frontend experiences with robust backend architecture.

Currently working on QueryHawk, an open-source, comprehensive SQL database monitoring and visualization tool designed to empower developers and database administrators to optimize performance and quickly identify bottlenecks. 

I recently gave a Tech Talk, sponsored by Scismic, in which I discussed end-to-end testing with Cypress, including core concepts such as stubbing, time-travel debugging, and custom assertions.

When I'm not coding, you can find me enjoying live music or hiking.

Find me on Github: https://github.com/meaganlewis.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed a database performance analytics platform using Node.js, Express, and Typescript, aggregating SQL latency and database metrics for enhanced observability, enabling developers to see performance metrics and proactively scale resources based on query execution patterns and database metrics
• Engineered containerized architecture using Docker, with easy configuration and multi-container orchestration with Docker Compose, to streamline deployment and ensure consistent performance across dev and prod environments while offering portability
• Developed automated OpenTelemetry metric collection system that reduced setup time while providing real-time insights that allow users to see database performance metrics and optimize query techniques as well as a query comparison tool to improve execution time by 60% and lower cost by 25%
• Implemented comprehensive monitoring using Grafana dashboards and Prometheus exporters, providing real-time visibility into system health and performance metrics including latency and cache hit ratio, displaying areas for improvement
• Created a React frontend, leveraging hooks and lifecycle methods to implement state management and data visualization for live-updating metrics
• Integrated Material UI components with Grafana iframes to create a cohesive interface, customizing theme elements and implementing responsive layouts that maintained performance and efficient rendering during high-frequency data updates
• Incorporated distributed tracing using OpenTelemetry and Jaeger to make system interactions easier to understand, enabling end-to-end request path monitoring to quickly identify bottlenecks, allowing for optimization of queries and API-to-database transactions
• Collaborated on a team of 4, using Git version control and Agile methodologies by holding standups and sprints, defining goals and deadlines with Lucidchart, overcoming technical blocks, and celebrating successes as well as holding retros to improve going forward

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Contributed to the development of a full-stack application that enables developers to store, categorize, and execute algorithms in a sandbox environment
• Created a component-centric frontend using React, leveraging React Hooks for state management to efficiently handle code snippet storage, filtering, and UI interactions, while integrating Material UI for a polished and consistent user experience
• Designed and implemented a RESTful API using Express.js, integrating PostgreSQL via Supabase to facilitate CRUD operations on code snippets
• Created a sandboxed iframe environment to execute Javascript code in the browser to provide an interactive coding experience with real-time execution feedback for the user

company.name: Code Card | Software Engineer | Algorithm Organization and JavaScript Sandbox Environment

positions.title: Content Editor (Senior Content Associate)
positions.description:
• Collaborated with pharmacists and editors to manage complex drug information monographs in proprietary CMS, ensuring data integrity and clinical accuracy
• Edited, peer reviewed, and published structured content updates in monographs via proprietary healthcare CMS, ensuring data consistency across web, mobile, and API service layers to help pharmacists and clinicians with point-of-care decision-making to increase patient safety in hospitals and retail pharmacies globally
• Collaborated with technical editors on XML structure validation and CMS troubleshooting to address workflow interruptions quickly
• Conducted and documented user acceptance testing (UAT) for software development team, identifying bugs and usability issues before production release and collaborated with developers to verify fixes and improvements after release to ensure a seamless experience for users with minimal downtime
• Implemented HTML corrections for website content and publishing systems, adding appropriate formatting, breadcrumbs, and CSS styling
• Led biweekly quality issues team meetings, documented issues, corrected content in the CMS, and communicated with external teams to alert them of the issue as well as developed and maintained documentation for procedures and best practices for handling errors in drug information content
• Designed and implemented DE&I online content guide for Wolters Kluwer Health employees using ZeroHeight, resulting in a company Global Sustainability Award
